featured_reviews.review_text:
Alert to all future shoppers!
1. This store is NOT the same as Silver Plaza which is across the street. Not sure which store came first and tried to adopt a similar sounding name deviously, but you should definitely avoid this store - Silver Plus is a BAD experience.
2. They mark up prices and pretend they are giving you a discount. Their selection is poor. They are trying to desperately get rid of their inventory.

Now that I'm reading several other reviews posted here, I can see this is a pattern - they are rude, clueless about customer service, and downright outdated business-wise. They haven't kept up with the times, their management is oblivious about competition. It is difficult to visualize how they will survive as a business.

Steer clear of this store. Run.
